If you loved Freida McFadden's The Housemaid and The Divorce you don't want to miss The Good Mother! This unbelievably twisty read will have you up late into the night.

'A shocking-to-the-core ending!' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

'A proper cracker!' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

'Had me hooked from the very start.' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

'Kept me on the edge of my seat!' ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

Vicky Seagrave is the perfect mother.

She’ll do anything for her babies – to make them happy, to keep them safe.

So when she hears her son crying she rushes to check on him. As she walks into the room, her heart stops: she’s horrified to find a strange man holding him.

This is every mother’s nightmare.

And it’s all her fault.

The mistake she made this morning has changed everything. Now someone is making her pay for it.

If she doesn’t find out who, they will take away her children – forever.
